asset_provenance: One original full-building RGBA generated from the exact158x151 source crop and two-hole structural guide. Original PNG retained byte-for-byte.
contact_explanation: Visible wall-contact paths are measured on the whole original generated RGBA; south-front uses its actual solid-alpha bottom per raw column. Hidden contacts and roof-support association are approximate visual depth, not surveyed geometry. All original three physics polygons remain unchanged. Courtyard walking is not enabled.
surface_padding_policy: Every raw-domain texel has one valid ID, including transparent support. The unchanged bilinear RGBA alpha alone owns support; never discard by an empty source-pixel cell.
